projects.heading: Block Sign - Contract management platform
projects.description:
Participate in the developer team to build BlockSign, a platform that helps people create, store, and manage contracts transparently, securely, and irrevocably. Utilized Next.js to build the front-end, integrating Shadcn, AceternityUI, TailwindCSS, Lucide, and I18n for a robust UI/UX. Employed Zustand for state management and React Query to fetch data. The backend was built with NestJS, implementing functionalities such as upload and CRUD operations. Collaborated with the team leader to deploy microservices using NestJS through Kafka.

Technologies stack:

* As front-end: Typescript · Next.js · shadcn · Aceternity UI · Tailwind CSS · Lucide · I18n · Zod.

* As back-end: NestJS · MongoDB · ERD · Blockchain · I18n.

* GitHub · Slack · Agile Web Development · ClickUp · visily.
projects.title: Block Sign - Contract management platform

* Deliver high-quality user experience and optimize functionalities.

Technologies: Typescript, React, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Github, Trello,...

Additional Information:

* Worked under the guidance of Workshop Director Nguyen Tri Dinh.

* Handled other ad-hoc tasks as required.

Thank you for visiting our project page.

sideProjects.heading: Perry Toc Chien – A Seamless Dual Booking Platform at Perry
sideProjects.description:
Perry Project is a dynamic scheduling platform designed to connect users with their hosts effortlessly. With a focus on user experience and security, the platform offers:

* Dual Booking System: Schedule appointments with your host through an intuitive interface, allowing you to select the perfect time slots from a clear, interactive calendar.

* Secure Login & Email Verification: Users can easily register and log in, with robust email verification to ensure account authenticity and security.

* Easy Deposits via SePay: The integrated SePay payment gateway streamlines the deposit process, making transactions fast, secure, and hassle-free.

* FullCalendar Integration: Leveraging FullCalendar, Perry Project presents a comprehensive and user-friendly view of available time slots, enabling efficient booking management.

From registration to appointment confirmation, Perry Project delivers a smooth, transparent experience for both hosts and guests, ensuring every booking is managed with precision and ease.

Technologies stack:

* As front-end: Typescript · Next.js 15 · React 19 · shadcn · Aceternity UI · Tailwind CSS · Lucide · Zod · NextAuth.

* As back-end: Server Action · PrismaDB.

* GitHub · Vercel.
sideProjects.title: Perry Toc Chien – A Seamless Dual Booking Platform

workExperience.heading: Full-Stack Developer at TIEN PHONG CDS JSC
workExperience.description:
I have extensive experience in maintaining and enhancing system performance to meet evolving client requirements. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, I have designed reliable, scalable API solutions and ensured high availability and responsiveness through rigorous testing and troubleshooting. These efforts have directly improved system functionality and user experience.

OMNI-SERVICE APIs – API Endpoints

* Built and developed PHP-based API endpoints for systems such as Dai Thuan, King Coffee, Mutosi, ePro, and others.

* Optimized APIs to ensure stability, high performance, and scalability.

* Integrated Vincss Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication with robust error handling and session management to enhance security and user experience.

Xhero – Dai Nam LMS

* Designed and developed a Moodle-based learning management system (LMS) tailored to client requirements.

* Engaged directly with clients to ensure their needs were clearly understood and effectively implemented.

* Developed an attractive, responsive front-end landing page to provide a user-friendly interface.

Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism – VietnamFoodMap

* Developed the VietnamFoodMap module to showcase Vietnam’s rich culinary heritage through interactive maps and engaging user interfaces.

* Delivered a solution that met both functional requirements and cultural preservation goals, ensuring a seamless and immersive user experience.
workExperience.title: Full-Stack Developer
